# Security

Report vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/MrewyOrg/Botge/security/advisories/new).
Do not publish exploit details, credentials, or private guild data in public issues or discussions.

Include the affected version or image digest, deployment type, impact, and a minimal reproduction
with secrets removed. Coordinate public disclosure with the maintainer after a fix is available.

## Supported versions

Security fixes target the latest released Rust version and `main`. Older releases and the retired
TypeScript bot are unsupported; upgrade before requesting a backport.

## Response

The maintainer aims to acknowledge reports within seven days. This is a best-effort target, not an
on-call service guarantee. If no response arrives, follow up on the private report after seven days.

## Preferred Language

English.
